question: Should OpenClaw accept SourceActor plus scalar SourceActor* fields, exported from openclaw/plugin-sdk/reply-runtime, as the stable generic channel source-attribution contract?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically coherent, but it expands public plugin SDK and model-visible prompt context; automation can verify shape and tests but cannot choose the permanent API and trust boundary.

options.title: Accept SourceActor contract
options.body: Land after prerequisite stack order is settled, making SourceActor canonical and SourceActor* supported scalar prompt mirrors.

options.title: Keep structured-only attribution
options.body: Ask the author to remove or narrow scalar SourceActor* prompt fields if maintainers do not want them as public API.

options.title: Defer attribution expansion
options.body: Pause this PR if source attribution should wait for a broader durable provenance design.

recommendation.title: Accept SourceActor contract
recommendation.body: Land after prerequisite stack order is settled, making SourceActor canonical and SourceActor* supported scalar prompt mirrors.
